stayUnitKeys.description: Unit keys of the arriving Screen's homes whose part may stay on the outgoing Screen until the step ends, each a LEB128 varuint. Empty by default.

flightAnimationId.description: The step's flight timeline: its index among the LinearAnimations of the Screen that holds the step's flight slots, counted as an AnimationState's animationId counts them. Take-off applies its tracks on those flight slots at time 0. Unset, take-off writes nothing.
